rules: All wiki files must conform to the schema in wiki/_schema/ for their type
Every JSON file has the top-level keys: meta, quick_facts, content, audit
meta.version increments by 1 on every file update. Never reset
audit array records every create/update action with version, timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC), author (skill name), action, note
All _index.json files list only slug names (no paths). Viewers resolve paths from section prefix
Never hard-delete wiki entries. Set quick_facts.status = 'deprecated' instead
API contract files follow wiki/_schema/contract.schema.json strictly
Sprint-end audit checklist must be completed. See skills/vibe-documentation/references/wiki-audit-checklist.md
Wiki changes committed with message: wiki(section): brief summary of change
